spellbook_fire_spark.name: Spellbook of Fire Spark
spellbook_fire_spark.lore: An apprentice's first fire cantrip. A candle-hot dart of flame is enough to teach the shape of the spell.

spellbook_fire_bolt.name: Spellbook of Fire Bolt
spellbook_fire_bolt.lore: A bolt of concentrated flame. Dangerous to fire-resistant creatures, devastating to the rest.

spellbook_fireball.name: Spellbook of Fireball
spellbook_fireball.lore: The quintessential battle mage's spell. A rolling sphere of flame engulfs everything in sight.

spellbook_meteor.name: Spellbook of Meteor
spellbook_meteor.lore: A fragment of a dying star, summoned from the void and hurled into the material plane. Everything in sight burns.

spellbook_cataclysm.name: Spellbook of Cataclysm
spellbook_cataclysm.lore: The final chapter of the Book of the Sky-Fall. Five meteors, one word, no survivors within sight.

spellbook_frost_touch.name: Spellbook of Frost Touch
spellbook_frost_touch.lore: Bound in seal-skin, the pages still cold to the touch decades after copying. The first ice-cantrip every Lapp shaman learned.

spellbook_cold_bolt.name: Spellbook of Cold Bolt
spellbook_cold_bolt.lore: A shard of ice hurled at speed. The pages shed thin frost when handled.

spellbook_ice_storm.name: Spellbook of Ice Storm
spellbook_ice_storm.lore: Freezing shards blast every visible monster. A battlefield-clearing spell.

spellbook_cone_of_cold.name: Spellbook of Cone of Cold
spellbook_cone_of_cold.lore: Annals of Norilsk: thirty years of arctic-mage observations. A widening cone of glacial cold that freezes flesh in a heartbeat.

spellbook_spark.name: Spellbook of Spark
spellbook_spark.lore: The apprentice's first lightning cantrip. A crackling spark leaps between fingers when the words land right.

spellbook_lightning_bolt.name: Spellbook of Lightning Bolt
spellbook_lightning_bolt.lore: Tesla's diary copy of the bolt-line incantation. Margin notes question whether the chalk was the resonator.

spellbook_chain_lightning.name: Spellbook of Chain Lightning
spellbook_chain_lightning.lore: Storm-singer's grimoire. Lightning forks through target after target, weakening with each arc.

spellbook_storm_of_vengeance.name: Spellbook of Storm of Vengeance
spellbook_storm_of_vengeance.lore: Zeus-rite copied by an Athenian heretic in 320 BCE. He was struck by lightning shortly after. The book was not.

spellbook_magic_dart.name: Spellbook of Magic Dart
spellbook_magic_dart.lore: The absolute first spell every apprentice masters. A single dart of pure force, which never misses.

spellbook_magic_missile.name: Spellbook of Magic Missile
spellbook_magic_missile.lore: Three unerring darts of pure magical force. The archetypal wizardly attack -- no defence stops it.

spellbook_force_barrage.name: Spellbook of Force Barrage
spellbook_force_barrage.lore: Five darts of shrieking force. The apprentice-mage's answer to a fully armored knight.

spellbook_force_storm.name: Spellbook of Force Storm
spellbook_force_storm.lore: A storm of seven force darts. No armour, no shield, no ward has ever turned them.

spellbook_annihilation.name: Spellbook of Annihilation
spellbook_annihilation.lore: Final chapter of the Liber Nihili. Weakened creatures vaporize; the rest are torn nearly in half.

spellbook_acid_dart.name: Spellbook of Acid Dart
spellbook_acid_dart.lore: A splash of biting acid. The apprentice's answer to armoured foes -- the metal itself begins to hiss.

spellbook_acid_arrow.name: Spellbook of Acid Arrow
spellbook_acid_arrow.lore: An arrow of pure acid that burns on impact and continues to corrode flesh over time.

spellbook_dissolution.name: Spellbook of Dissolution
spellbook_dissolution.lore: A green torrent that eats through steel, stone, and bone alike. Reserved for the enemies you truly hate.

spellbook_cure_light.name: Spellbook of Cure Light Wounds
spellbook_cure_light.lore: Field-medicine compendium from a battlefield priest. Cures minor wounds; the first healing prayer every acolyte learns.

spellbook_cure_wounds.name: Spellbook of Cure Wounds
spellbook_cure_wounds.lore: The workhorse healing prayer. Every temple physician's second-year reader.

spellbook_heal.name: Spellbook of Heal
spellbook_heal.lore: Channels restorative energy. The major healing word.

spellbook_greater_heal.name: Spellbook of Greater Heal
spellbook_greater_heal.lore: Galen's Greater Healing -- recovered from the Library of Alexandria fire by an apprentice who lost his arm carrying it out.

spellbook_resurrection.name: Spellbook of Resurrection
spellbook_resurrection.lore: Lazarus liturgy -- full text, with the rabbinical disclaimer that nobody who has tried it has reported their experience usefully.

spellbook_sleep.name: Spellbook of Sleep
spellbook_sleep.lore: A gentle enchantment that sends a single creature into sudden slumber.

spellbook_mass_sleep.name: Spellbook of Mass Sleep
spellbook_mass_sleep.lore: Lullaby of the Watchman of Antioch -- read aloud, every sleeper in the room dreams of the same hill.

spellbook_deep_slumber.name: Spellbook of Deep Slumber
spellbook_deep_slumber.lore: The final chapter of the Antioch Lullabies. Every ear in sight hears the same silence.

spellbook_slow.name: Spellbook of Slow
spellbook_slow.lore: Temporal magic that saps the speed from a creature, leaving it sluggish and vulnerable.

spellbook_mass_slow.name: Spellbook of Mass Slow
spellbook_mass_slow.lore: Temporal magic broadcast across a battlefield. Every visible foe stumbles as if wading through honey.

spellbook_time_freeze.name: Spellbook of Time Freeze
spellbook_time_freeze.lore: To freeze time itself -- the ambition that drove the greatest chronomancers to madness. For five heartbeats, nothing moves.

spellbook_hold_monster.name: Spellbook of Hold Monster
spellbook_hold_monster.lore: Locks a single creature in magical stasis. The apprentice's first crowd-control cantrip.

spellbook_paralyze.name: Spellbook of Paralyze
spellbook_paralyze.lore: The stronger binding. Even the most fearsome creatures cannot move while paralyzed by this word.

spellbook_mass_paralyze.name: Spellbook of Mass Paralyze
spellbook_mass_paralyze.lore: Carpathian witch's recipe -- paralysis was always her preferred technique, never the killing blow.

spellbook_fear.name: Spellbook of Fear
spellbook_fear.lore: Projects raw terror into a creature's mind, sending it fleeing in panic.

spellbook_terror.name: Spellbook of Terror
spellbook_terror.lore: The unspeakable Word of Terror. Every visible foe drops their weapon and runs.

spellbook_confusion.name: Spellbook of Confusion
spellbook_confusion.lore: Scrambles a monster's senses. A confused enemy attacks randomly and loses coordination.

spellbook_madness.name: Spellbook of Madness
spellbook_madness.lore: The Word of Madness, whispered in the tongue of things that should not be. Every mind in sight breaks.

spellbook_mage_armor.name: Spellbook of Mage Armor
spellbook_mage_armor.lore: Mage Armor: the most fundamental defensive cantrip. Every wizards' college copy is dog-eared at this page.

spellbook_magic_shield.name: Spellbook of Magic Shield
spellbook_magic_shield.lore: A shimmering barrier that halves physical blows and improves your defenses.

spellbook_stoneskin.name: Spellbook of Stoneskin
spellbook_stoneskin.lore: Dwarven Cantor's diary. The pages describe the breath-technique that hardens the body to stone.

spellbook_haste.name: Spellbook of Haste
spellbook_haste.lore: Accelerates your body to superhuman speed, granting a free second action each turn.

spellbook_greater_haste.name: Spellbook of Greater Haste
spellbook_greater_haste.lore: Mercury's own footfalls, transcribed by a runner who no longer needed to breathe.

spellbook_invisibility.name: Spellbook of Invisibility
spellbook_invisibility.lore: Bends light around you. Invisibility is not invulnerability, but it is close.

spellbook_greater_invisibility.name: Spellbook of Greater Invisibility
spellbook_greater_invisibility.lore: Tarnhelm research notes from the Bayreuth Festival library -- three Wagner-era scholars vanished while reading it.

spellbook_displacement.name: Spellbook of Displacement
spellbook_displacement.lore: Projects a false image of you, causing attackers to strike at empty air.

spellbook_reflect.name: Spellbook of Spell Reflect
spellbook_reflect.lore: Creates a shimmering aura that bounces hostile magic and status effects back at their source.

spellbook_detect_magic.name: Spellbook of Detect Magic
spellbook_detect_magic.lore: Dee's earliest divination tract -- translation from the original Enochian, partial fragments only.

spellbook_identify.name: Spellbook of Identify
spellbook_identify.lore: The Adept's Identification. Reveals the true nature of magical items on the floor and in your pack.

spellbook_omnisight.name: Spellbook of Omnisight
spellbook_omnisight.lore: The archmage's true sight. Every enchanted thing you carry -- pack, hand, and hilt -- names itself.

spellbook_detect_monsters.name: Spellbook of Detect Monsters
spellbook_detect_monsters.lore: Expands the caster's awareness to sense every living creature on the level.

spellbook_foresight.name: Spellbook of Foresight
spellbook_foresight.lore: Cassandra's notes, copied centuries later by a librarian who later refused to admit knowing what was in them.

spellbook_mapping.name: Spellbook of Mapping
spellbook_mapping.lore: Geomancer's pocket-folio: ink lines that reveal themselves when held over candle smoke.

spellbook_greater_mapping.name: Spellbook of Greater Mapping
spellbook_greater_mapping.lore: The master geomancer's revised folio -- foes and treasure appear on the map alongside the walls.

spellbook_blink.name: Spellbook of Blink
spellbook_blink.lore: An apprentice's first teleportation primer. Includes a footnote warning against blinking over deep water.

spellbook_phase_door.name: Spellbook of Phase Door
spellbook_phase_door.lore: Bilocation manual by the unknown St-Germain. The author's name still spreads slowly through the table of contents.

spellbook_gate.name: Spellbook of Gate
spellbook_gate.lore: Crowley's annotated translation of the Lemegeton gate-rite. Several entries in the index are crossed out by a different hand.

spellbook_turn_undead.name: Spellbook of Turn Undead
spellbook_turn_undead.lore: Vesper-prayer compendium -- clerical, but the working incantation is the same one wizards use.

spellbook_sunburst.name: Spellbook of Sunburst
spellbook_sunburst.lore: Solar liturgy of the dawn-priests of Heliopolis. When read aloud, every dead thing in sight remembers it is dead.

spellbook_polymorph.name: Spellbook of Polymorph
spellbook_polymorph.lore: Warps reality around a creature, transforming it into something else entirely. Results vary.

spellbook_mass_polymorph.name: Spellbook of Mass Polymorph
spellbook_mass_polymorph.lore: Circe's school-notes from her time on Aeaea. Footnotes mention various species considered for the conversion.

spellbook_drain_life.name: Spellbook of Drain Life
spellbook_drain_life.lore: Vampiric magic that tears life force from a creature and channels it into the caster.

spellbook_soul_drain.name: Spellbook of Soul Drain
spellbook_soul_drain.lore: The vampire-lord's Drain, refined. The victim's own life sustains the caster for the next fight.

spellbook_light.name: Spellbook of Light
spellbook_light.lore: Banishes shadows. Simple, essential, and often the spell that saves lives.

spellbook_knock.name: Spellbook of Knock
spellbook_knock.lore: A locksmith's nightmare. This spell opens any mundane lock with a burst of arcane force.

spellbook_cleanse.name: Spellbook of Cleanse
spellbook_cleanse.lore: A healer's primer on purification magic. One incantation removes any single affliction -- poison, paralysis, disease, curse.

spellbook_empower.name: Spellbook of Empower
spellbook_empower.lore: A war-mage's secret: channel arcane energy into a physical weapon for a single devastating strike.

spellbook_levitate.name: Spellbook of Levitate
spellbook_levitate.lore: St Joseph of Cupertino's confessional notes -- the saint who could not stop floating.

spellbook_teleport_away.name: Spellbook of Teleport Away
spellbook_teleport_away.lore: Spatial magic that hurls a creature to a random location on the level. Or yourself, if you prefer.

spellbook_smite.name: Spellbook of Smite
spellbook_smite.lore: The word of divine judgment, written in letters of fire. Bypasses all mortal resistances.

spellbook_dispel_magic.name: Spellbook of Dispel Magic
spellbook_dispel_magic.lore: The Latin original of the rite -- late-Renaissance, copied off a folio Dee burned but didn't burn well enough.

spellbook_counterspell.name: Spellbook of Counterspell
spellbook_counterspell.lore: Mordenkainen's Argument -- a single chapter on undoing another's working before it lands.

spellbook_summon_guardian.name: Spellbook of Summon Guardian
spellbook_summon_guardian.lore: Druids of the ancient groves could call spirit-beasts from the aether to fight alongside them.

spellbook_disintegrate.name: Spellbook of Disintegrate
spellbook_disintegrate.lore: The ultimate destruction spell. Reduces a creature to dust with a single word of power.

spellbook_power_word_kill.name: Spellbook of Power Word Kill
spellbook_power_word_kill.lore: The Vorpal Word, the cantrip the headsmen kept secret. One syllable. Several deaths.

spellbook_wish.name: Spellbook of Wish
spellbook_wish.lore: A single page. The page is blank. Read it anyway.

spellbook_imprisonment.name: Spellbook of Imprisonment
spellbook_imprisonment.lore: Persian source-text on binding-into-stone -- used originally against a particular djinn who was getting out of hand.

spellbook_banishment.name: Spellbook of Banishment
spellbook_banishment.lore: Solomon's binding-rite, distilled to the essentials. Useful only against what came from elsewhere.

spellbook_army_of_darkness.name: Spellbook of Army of Darkness
spellbook_army_of_darkness.lore: Raise the dead to serve you. Five will answer the call. Do not read this aloud in a graveyard.

necronomicon.name: The Necronomicon
necronomicon.unidentified_name: a book bound in human flesh
necronomicon.lore: Naturom Demonto -- roughly translated, the Book of the Dead. Bound in human flesh and inked in blood, this ancient Sumerian text contains funeral incantations, demon resurrection passages, and prophecies. It is NOT to be read aloud. Seriously. Don't.

sefer_yetzirah.name: Sefer Yetzirah (The Book of Formation)
sefer_yetzirah.lore: The Book of Formation. Attributed to Abraham; the oldest extant Jewish mystical text. It teaches the twenty-two letters of the Hebrew alphabet and the ten sefirot, and how the world was spoken into being. The Maharal of Prague used a copy in the sixteenth century to shape a golem of clay; the golem walked the streets of the Jewish quarter until the Maharal removed the Name from its forehead.

picatrix.name: Picatrix
picatrix.lore: Picatrix -- Ghayat al-Hakim, the Aim of the Sage. Composed in tenth-century al-Andalus, translated to Latin under Alfonso X, and read across Europe for the next four centuries. It teaches talismanic magic, planetary hours, and how to summon fire by naming a planet's degree of ascension. Dee owned a copy. Ficino read it carefully and pretended he hadn't.

lemegeton.name: Lemegeton (The Lesser Key of Solomon)
lemegeton.unidentified_name: a black tome sealed with sigils
lemegeton.lore: The Lemegeton. Five books bound as one; the first, the Ars Goetia, lists the seventy-two demons King Solomon bound to his service. Each demon has a sigil, a number of legions, and a particular use -- Bael teaches invisibility, Asmodeus answers questions truthfully, Vassago finds lost things. Crowley translated it in 1904. Read it carefully.

book_of_thoth.name: Book of Thoth
book_of_thoth.unidentified_name: a heavy book bound in papyrus and gold
book_of_thoth.lore: A book of a book of a book. Thoth hid it at the bottom of the Nile in a box of iron in a box of bronze in a box of ebony in a box of ivory in a box of silver in a box of gold, and a serpent that cannot die was set to guard it. To read it once is to know everything the world holds today; to read it wrong is to lose the pieces you had.
